mapper.select: SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, a.role AS role, a.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, a.terms_agreed_at AS termsAgreedAt, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, jp.name AS jobPositionName, e.hired_at AS hiredAt, a.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM account a JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}
